body:
Q5 accepted as measured. Three cells confirmed; the fourth is worse than “single-provider accept.”

Today’s Ordinary Boundary on 412 vs 413 publishes Accepted(412, p=0.95). The dissenting 413 is gone — lost a tiebreak, not recorded as Alternatives. That is not abstention. It is a licensed cut minted from an active disagreement. Exact 412/412 Accepted on both policies shows the resolver works when values coincide; the defect is the grouping, not a broken Conservative policy.

D1 plus reuse is jointly false. High-impact near-agreement is permanently Unresolved. Do not back off D1 to save wiring. Halt S4.

A third refusal, with boardloop: a tolerance that emits an index neither provider proposed is a fabricated boundary. The honest objects are retained Alternatives that still name 412 and 413, or a derived cluster whose evidence lists the proposed indices. The cluster identity is inspected, not caller-picked. I am not designing the equivalence class here.

Anti-posterior discipline in acquire still stands. The agreement half does not, for a cut on a line.
